note: Every data source of the twin. kind: real | estimated | simulated | restricted. Endpoints were tested on 2026-11-13 unless status says otherwise.

roma_geoserver.what: PRG, Carta per la Qualita, Rete Ecologica, UNESCO, schools, hospitals, municipi, sports facilities
roma_geoserver.licence: not stated in capabilities; credit Roma Capitale - GeoPortale (CC BY assumed, confidence 60)

lazio_geoserver.what: PTPR Tavola A/B, Natura 2000, AGEA orthophotos

osm.what: Roads, POIs, playgrounds, care homes, masts, private sports venues
osm.status: not tested from the research sandbox

mase_lidar.what: 1 m surface and terrain models (2008-2011), about a third of the centre along the Tiber

megascenes.what: About 896 Rome landmark photo scenes with camera poses
megascenes.redistribution: derived models with attribution; not raw photos

eea_hourly.what: Hourly air quality, 13 Rome NO2 points

roma_ckan.what: 365 open datasets (Wi-Fi sessions, accidents, sports centres 2018...)
roma_ckan.licence: mostly CC BY; exclude the 11 non-commercial ones

cartoradio_grid.what: National estimated E-field grid in V/m, 100 m cells (EPSG:3857), float32, nodata -9999
cartoradio_grid.access: cloud-optimised GeoTIFF, read the Rome window by byte range at runtime
cartoradio_grid.licence: legal notes forbid reuse; written consent from MIMIT/FUB pending (cartoradio@fub.it)

sim_register.what: Antenna installation register seeded from OpenCelliD and OSM
sim_register.licence: inherits CC BY-SA / ODbL from its seeds

gba_lod1.what: GlobalBuildingAtlas LoD1: building polygons with a machine-learning height and its variance (PlanetScope imagery)
gba_lod1.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial; accepted by the project owner on 2026-11-13)
gba_lod1.status: verified, used by the G0 city model (WS2)

urban_atlas_building_height.what: Copernicus Urban Atlas Building Height 2012, 10 m, as 10 height classes; core urban area only
urban_atlas_building_height.licence: Copernicus data policy: free and open, attribution
urban_atlas_building_height.status: verified, used as fallback height and as the independent height check (WS2)

copernicus_dem_glo30.what: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 surface model (30 m), ground level under buildings until TINITALY is wired in
copernicus_dem_glo30.access: Cloud-optimised GeoTIFF on AWS, no login
copernicus_dem_glo30.licence: Copernicus DEM licence: free, attribution ('produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018')

mase_lidar_download_api.what: MASE LiDAR DSM First and DTM, 1 m, flown 2008-2011: 1,265 surveyed 1 km tiles over Roma Capitale (far more than the Tiber strip)
mase_lidar_download_api.access: POST a tile list (grid: gis.platform.sim.mase.gov.it Grigliato_lidar layer 2), poll the session, download the ZIP; see scripts/build_lidar.py
mase_lidar_download_api.status: download tested 13 Nov 2026; tiles align with Overture footprints within 1 m
